# Maskinval

> Maskinval (maskinval.se) is a Swedish, brand-neutral site for choosing pneumatic and industrial automation components. One catalogue covers about 800 articles from eight manufacturers — Festo, SMC, AVENTICS, Metal Work, Camozzi, Parker, Norgren and Bosch Rexroth — with technical data, cross-brand equivalents and quote requests. The site is in Swedish (sv), English (en), German (de) and Spanish (es).

Prices are given on quote. Lead times shown on the site are estimates and are confirmed in the quote. Technical values come from the manufacturers' catalogues; where a value is missing the site says so instead of guessing.

## Main tools

- [Product catalogue](https://maskinval.se/en/products): cylinders, valves, grippers, vacuum, air preparation, fittings, sensors and electric axes. Filter by category, brand, bore (ISO 3320 sizes) and standard (ISO 6432, ISO 15552, ISO 21287).
- [Replace a component](https://maskinval.se/en/replace): enter an order code or photograph the type plate and get the same article or equivalents from other brands.
- [Compare](https://maskinval.se/en/compare): side-by-side technical data across brands.
- [Machine builder](https://maskinval.se/en/machine-builder): describe a machine task in your own words; the site shows how it read the requirements, asks follow-up questions, proposes components with a requirement status per alternative, and builds a bill of materials.
- [Control & PLC](https://maskinval.se/en/plc): turns a machine description into signal lists, sequences and open questions for the programmer. Addresses are never invented.
- [Configurator](https://maskinval.se/en/configurator): build a full order code for a cylinder or valve series.
- [Buying guides](https://maskinval.se/en/guider): how to size a cylinder, choose a valve, and more, with the formulas used.
- [Cylinder calculator](https://maskinval.se/en/verktyg/cylinderkraft): theoretical and usable force on extend and retract, the smallest bore for a load, and air consumption in Nl/min — the same model the machine builder uses.

## How equivalents are chosen

An equivalent must be the same kind of component (for example a round ISO 6432 cylinder is only compared with other round cylinders) and must exist in the same bore. The site states what matches — "same standard (ISO 6432), same bore Ø8" — and nothing more.
